page: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-22 is a general-purpose virtual machine configuration based on Intel Xeon 8481C processors. It provides 22 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 11 physical cores at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz, supported by hyper-threading. The compute subsystem includes 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 105 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity totals 88.0 GB, providing an exact 1:4 ratio of 4.0 GB RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration includes instruction sets such as AVX-512, Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) with amx_tile and amx_int8 support, and cryptographic extensions like VAES and SHA-NI.

Benchmark results position the instance primarily within average tiers across general compute and memory evaluations. The system recorded a Geekbench multi-core score of 12159.0 and a single-core score of 1715.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 27864.91. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 106.75 GB/sec, while write operations achieve 46.35 GB/sec. In AI inference benchmarks, the presence of AMX instructions enables a strong text generation speed of 296.59 tokens per second on a small 135M parameter language model, falling within the top quartile, while medium 7B model generation operates at an average 16.68 tokens per second.

The instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage, meaning all persistent storage relies on attached network volumes. Hardware acceleration is limited to CPU-native instruction sets, as there are no discrete GPUs. Additionally, complimentary public IPv4 networking addresses are not provisioned with the instance.

With its 1:4 processor-to-memory allocation, Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-22 fits mainstream enterprise workloads. The configuration is suitable for multi-threaded compilation tasks (scoring 19762.0 in Clang benchmarks), static web serving (tested at 30.99 GB/sec), in-memory caching platforms such as Redis (recording 23.04 million SET operations per second), relational database operations, and CPU-based lightweight machine learning inference.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-22 is a general-purpose server powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor operating at 2.7 GHz. Built on an x86_64 architecture, it delivers 22 dedicated vCPUs across 11 physical cores paired with 88.0 GB of memory, preserving a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio. Hardware support includes AVX-512 and Intel AMX matrix extensions, enabling competitive performance in select machine learning operations such as small-model LLM text generation (296.59 tokens/sec). General benchmark results—such as a PassMark CPU score of 27864.91 and Geekbench multi-core score of 12159.0—place it in average performance brackets. The instance bundles no local NVMe storage or discrete GPUs, relying on remote block storage for data persistence. It is well-suited for web serving, database hosting, code compilation, and in-memory key-value stores.
